_comment: Canonical publish queue read by the GitHub Actions publishers. Paths are repo-relative (served via raw.githubusercontent.com). The reel workflow picks the first ready REELS item due today (ICT); the poster workflow picks the first ready IMAGE item. Set status to 'ready' only once the media file is committed to this repo.
